rows.title: QumulusAI expands closed equipment lease financing with Tech Finance Co. (TFC) to approximately $123.6 million
rows.detail: Three-year leases funding NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs bought in May and July 2026; TFC financed 85% to 90% of equipment cost per schedule, customer deposits the balance; no new equity; implied high single-digit annualized interest rate; end-of-term buy or return options. Amount as stated: approximately $123.6 million (up from $26.0 million announced May 7, 2026).
